newsitem.title: USA: Web advertising sales soar in 1st half '97 -- report.
newsitem.headline: Web advertising sales soar in 1st half '97 -- report.

text.p: Web advertising revenue exploded in the first half of this year, totaling $217.3 million and rising 256.2 percent over the first half of 1996, said Electronic Advertising & Marketplace Report, a biweekly newsletter published by Cowles/Simba Information.
The market grew 58.7 percent to $133.3 million in the second quarter, up $84.0 million from the first quarter.

"If Web advertising in 1997 follows the trends of 1996, Web publishers will experience a summer slowdown in the third quarter in which revenue will drop, followed by a booming fourth quarter as advertisers gear up for the holiday season," said Matt Kinsman, editor of EAMR.
Search engines continued to be the dominant advertising forum, technology publishers comprised the second largest market, and the growing consumer/news category came in third, EAMR said.
Cowles/Simba Information is a provider of news, analysis, and market research reports on the media and information industry. It is a unit of Cowles Business Media in Stamford, CT.
